## Why visit

A modest traditional stop that gives a central walking route some breathing space between the famous beer destinations. The small rooms and backstreet position are the attraction, with a documented cask offering after refurbishment. It is worth including when you want to see how a compact everyday city pub feels, rather than another large tap list. The reduced range matters: older guides promising five cask choices are no longer a sound planning basis. Pair it with City Arms or Gas Lamp and judge the day’s beer at the bar.

## Beer

CAMRA reports that the October 2025 reopening reduced the cask range from five to two. Ask which beers are genuinely cask-conditioned.

## Plan the visit

A route addition for traditional-pub enthusiasts rather than a specialist-range anchor. Older descriptions of its beer breadth are outdated.

**Getting there:** Walk from St Peter’s Square or Deansgate; convenient between City Arms and the Bridge Street area.
